news.title: Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis
news.summary_raw:
Talos was built to help resolve a major bottleneck in genomic medicine: human review time. The open-source system recovered 90% of in-scope diagnoses while surfacing just 1.3 candidate variants per patient for expert review. 
The post Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has developed an open-source AI system called Talos that automates and iteratively refines genome analysis for rare disease diagnosis. This AI-powered system recovers 90% of diagnoses and surface approximately 1.3 candidate variants for human review.
news.enterprise_use: This technology is not directly relevant to IT infrastructure, but it highlights the potential for AI in healthcare and genomic medicine, which could lead to new medical treatments and services.
